description: Byte-level contract of iap.contracts.versions.canonical_json and iap.trace.digest.TraceDigest; every language port must reproduce each field exactly (see python/tools/make_golden_canonical_json.py).

rules.keys: sorted by Unicode code point of the raw key, recursively
rules.ascii: non-ASCII escaped as \uXXXX (UTF-16 surrogate pairs above U+FFFF); '/' not escaped
rules.floats: shortest round-trip digits; exponent form iff decimal exponent < -4 or >= 16; exponent written as e-05 / e+16 (sign, at least two digits); integral values keep '.0'
rules.line_hash: sha256 over ascii(line) + '\n' per trace, concatenated

string_escape.json: "unicode key ordering: Z z a A"

rejects.reason: non-finite float anywhere in the document
